SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.nickname, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.user_id = u.id THEN p.id END) AS publish_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.status = 2 THEN p.id END) AS sold_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.buyer_id = u.id THEN o.id END) AS buy_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.seller_id = u.id THEN o.deal_price ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_earning, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.buyer_id = u.id THEN o.deal_price ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_spending FROM user u LEFT JOIN product p ON u.id = p.user_id LEFT JOIN `order` o ON u.id = o.seller_id OR u.id = o.buyer_id WHERE u.role = 0 GROUP BY u.id, u.nickname ORDER BY total_earning DESC

SELECT sub.user_id, sub.nickname, sub.publish_count, 0 AS sold_count, 0 AS buy_count, 0 AS total_earning, 0 AS total_spending FROM ( SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.nickname, COUNT(p.id) AS publish_count FROM user u LEFT JOIN product p ON u.id = p.user_id WHERE u.role = 0 GROUP BY u.id, u.nickname ) sub WHERE sub.publish_count > ( SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM ( SELECT COUNT(p2.id) AS cnt FROM user u2 LEFT JOIN product p2 ON u2.id = p2.user_id WHERE u2.role = 0 GROUP BY u2.id ) avg_sub ) ORDER BY sub.publish_count DESC
